evidence.name: Screen field: Replay the video on a loop
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Replay the video on a loop" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Replay the video on a loop
sections.description: When on, the video replays continuously; when off, it plays once and stops on the last frame. Only applies to video media. Turn looping on for short ambient background clips that hold attention; turn it off for a demo or explainer you want watched once, so it doesn't loop distractingly while the visitor reads.
